purpose: Create a new, forward-only evidence boundary for adjudicating whether the already-confirmed HR per-PA component improves full-game HR-over-0.5 probabilities once the exact T-minus-4-hour lineup state and PA-volume distribution are retained. This is not a betting, economic, or model-promotion contract.

may_scope_incident.effect: May 2026 must not be used as a new untouched candidate holdout.

scope.population: only MLB hitter/player keys with a complete, time-stamped and identity-resolved forward input record
scope.confirmation_period: a new prospective period beginning only after this contract and its implementation are frozen
excluded_periods: any date captured before this contract is deployed

derivation_invariant.full_game_probability: must be deterministically recomputable from the stored T-4 PA distribution and stored T-4 per-PA HR probability; no later lineup, PA, outcome, or market field may enter
derivation_invariant.alternative_simulation_allowed_only_if: the complete seed, sampler version, PA distribution and per-PA probability are stored and reproduce the archived tail probability within the predeclared tolerance

required_mutations: replace a T-4 lineup receipt with a post-start receipt: must reject
replace PA distribution with realized official PA: must reject
remove a PA support probability or make probabilities not sum to one: must reject
change player or game identity after capture: must reject
delete raw payload or hash: must reject
create a partial publish or duplicate terminal state: must reject
join official outcome before MLB final status: must reject
attempt to treat a v13 operational-smoke row as a complete full-game HR record: must reject
failure_condition: Any access to May 2026 for a new candidate holdout, any modification of v13, absent or post-horizon lineup/PA evidence, incomplete identity/provenance, backfill, outcome leakage, silent exclusion, economic claim, betting authorization, or production-model change.
